T'Challa, the Black Panther.when: Turn 3 every game possible; recast early after removal — every Vibranium token and +2 counters snowball.
T'Challa, the Black Panther.target: Attack the opponent with the fewest blockers so each attack makes a Vibranium token.
T'Challa, the Black Panther.hold: Don't hold — he is the engine. Give him protection (Boots, Heroic Intervention, Vigorbloom) before big artifact turns.
T'Challa, the Black Panther.synergy: Every artifact with MV 4+ adds two +1/+1 counters; Vibranium tokens only cast artifacts, so sequence artifacts after he's down.

Akroma's Will.when: Your turn after blockers: choose both modes (you control your commander) for a double-strike, flying, lifelink, indestructible alpha strike.
Akroma's Will.hold: Hold as a finisher or as instant-speed protection in response to a wipe.
Akroma's Will.synergy: Doubles T'Challa's counters' damage; turns Loyal Guardian/Zuri counters into lethal.

Ancestral Communion.when: When T'Challa is on the battlefield (it copies) and two good permanents are in the graveyard.
Ancestral Communion.hold: Hold until a wipe or removal has hit two real threats.
Ancestral Communion.synergy: Copy needs your commander on board — don't cast it without T'Challa.

Arcane Signet.synergy: Makes turn-3 T'Challa + artifact turns possible.

Bast, Panther Goddess.when: Once you control 3+ creatures (tokens count); otherwise she can't attack or block.
Bast, Panther Goddess.target: Pump your biggest attacker with her attack trigger.
Bast, Panther Goddess.hold: Don't cast into an empty board.
Bast, Panther Goddess.synergy: Vibranium tokens aren't creatures — count Soldiers, Rhinos, Germs, Walls.

Beast Within.when: Instant answer to a must-answer permanent (combo piece, Ghalta, a key artifact/enchantment).
Beast Within.target: The single scariest permanent at the table; the 3/3 is a small price.
Beast Within.hold: Hold up on opponents' turns when you can afford it.
Beast Within.synergy: Flexible: hits enchantments/planeswalkers the creature removal can't.

Birds of Paradise.synergy: Fixes green/white; counts toward Bast's creature requirement.

Black Panther, Vanguard.when: Before your other Heroes so each Hero entering triggers him.
Black Panther, Vanguard.target: Choose Soldier tokens early, team pump on an attack turn.
Black Panther, Vanguard.synergy: Heroes in the deck: T'Challa, Shuri, Okoye, Zuri, W'Kabi, Storm, Nakia, T'Chaka, Invisible Woman.

Bronze Guardian.target: Attack the player with the fewest flyers/blockers — double strike.
Bronze Guardian.synergy: Gives every other artifact ward 2; Vibranium tokens pump it; MV 5 artifact → T'Challa counters.

Cauldron of Souls.when: Leave untapped before a wipe is likely; tap in response to give persist.
Cauldron of Souls.hold: It only works at instant speed in response — keep it untapped.
Cauldron of Souls.synergy: Persist returns T'Challa (counters reset) and engines.

Clever Concealment.when: Only in response to a board wipe or mass removal.
Clever Concealment.target: Every nonland permanent worth saving (T'Challa, engines, equipment).
Clever Concealment.hold: Hold it — never cast it proactively. Convoke means tapped creatures can still pay.
Clever Concealment.synergy: Phased-out equipment stays attached when it phases back in.

Conduit of Worlds.when: Mid-game after a wipe; replays lands from the graveyard.
Conduit of Worlds.hold: Cast early only if nothing better is available.
Conduit of Worlds.synergy: Stand-in in sims for your unrecorded 'Vibranium Cache'.

Dispatch.when: Once you have 3+ artifacts (metalcraft = exile for {W}).
Dispatch.target: Biggest threat (Ghalta, an angel, a commander you want gone).
Dispatch.hold: Hold until metalcraft is on; without it, use it only to tap a blocker for lethal.

Divine Visitation.synergy: Turns Soldiers/Rhinos into 4/4 fliers (Vibranium tokens are not creatures).

Everett K. Ross, Hapless Attaché.synergy: +1/+1 and lifelink on T'Challa; draws when you're swarmed.

Forsaken Monument.when: Turn 4–5 once you have colorless sources.
Forsaken Monument.synergy: Doubles colorless mana (Vibranium, Sol Ring, Thran Dynamo); +2/+2 to colorless creatures (Wurmcoil, Bronze Guardian, Germs, Eldrazi).

Foundry Inspector.synergy: Cheaper artifacts = more T'Challa/Zuri triggers sooner.

Ghostly Prison.when: Turn 3 against aggressive or token-heavy tables.
Ghostly Prison.synergy: Buys turns for the artifact engine to come online.

Greater Good.when: When you have creatures to cash in.
Greater Good.target: Sacrifice creatures that are about to die anyway (in response to removal/wipe).
Greater Good.synergy: Sac a big T'Challa in response to exile for a huge draw.

Hammer of Nazahn.synergy: Auto-attaches other equipment as it enters; MV 4 → counters.

Hatut Zeraze Strike Force.when: After you've recast T'Challa (copies per commander cast).

Helm of the Host.target: Wurmcoil, Bronze Guardian, Loyal Guardian — not T'Challa (copies aren't legendary but the original stays).

Heroic Intervention.when: In response to a wipe or targeted removal.

Idol of Oblivion.synergy: Every T'Challa attack makes a token → draw a card; late game, 10/10 Eldrazi (+2/+2 with Monument).

Ingenious Smith.target: Take the best artifact in the top four.

Invisible Woman, Sue Storm.synergy: Counters on other Heroes (Zuri, T'Challa via others) make 0/4 walls.

Kimoyo Beads.synergy: MV 4 → counters; card, tokens, life over three turns.

King Solomon's Frogs.when: Flash it in on an opponent's end step or in response.
King Solomon's Frogs.target: Each opponent's best permanent with MV 3+.
King Solomon's Frogs.hold: Hold for value (one target per opponent).

Kutzil, Malamet Exemplar.when: Before your big turn — opponents can't respond during your turn.
Kutzil, Malamet Exemplar.synergy: Counters from T'Challa/Zuri/Loyal Guardian make creatures above base power → draws.

Loyal Guardian.synergy: Lieutenant: +1/+1 counter on every creature every combat.

Loyal Retainers.target: Reanimate T'Challa? No — he goes to command zone; target Bast/Storm/Okoye/Traxos.

Metalwork Colossus.when: When noncreature artifact MV covers most of its cost.
Metalwork Colossus.synergy: Often free; recursion by sacrificing two Vibranium tokens.

Mirrormind Crown.when: Once you have a non-legendary threat and token makers.
Mirrormind Crown.target: Equip Wurmcoil, Bronze Guardian, Loyal Guardian — never T'Challa (legend rule kills the copies).
Mirrormind Crown.synergy: T'Challa's Vibranium tokens become copies of the equipped creature.

Mirrorworks.synergy: Each copy is a token (Idol draws).

Mystic Forge.synergy: Cast artifacts off the top; MV 4 → counters; near-combo with Foundry Inspector + Sensei's Top.

Nettlecyst.target: Germ first; later re-equip to T'Challa or an evasive creature.
Nettlecyst.synergy: +1/+1 per artifact/enchantment — Vibranium tokens grow it.

Okoye, Mighty and Adored.target: Counter on T'Challa each combat; attack the monarch.
Okoye, Mighty and Adored.synergy: Monarch card draw; double strike vs the monarch.

Overwhelming Stampede.hold: Hold until it's lethal or close.

Panther Habit.when: On T'Challa once he attacks into blockers.

Path to Exile.target: Ghalta, angels, voltron threats, combo creatures — not mana dorks.

Reconnaissance.when: Once you're attacking with several creatures.
Reconnaissance.target: Remove blocked attackers that would die; untap all attackers after damage (free vigilance).
Reconnaissance.synergy: Attack freely with T'Challa (Vibranium trigger) and still have him back as a blocker.

Shuri's Fabricator.target: Later: return your best dead artifact.

Shuri, the Black Panther.synergy: Draw on attack; +2/+2 team at 6 artifacts.

Solemn Simulacrum.synergy: MV 4 → counters; chump-blocks for a card.

Storm, Queen of Wakanda.synergy: Evasion for the biggest attacker; punishes flyers attacking you.

Swiftfoot Boots.when: Only once T'Challa or a key threat is on the battlefield — don't spend early turns on it.

Thousand Moons Smithy.synergy: Gnome scales with artifacts; can transform into a land.

Vanquish the Horde.hold: Hold until it's clearly one-sided in your favour.
Vanquish the Horde.synergy: Vibranium tokens and noncreature artifacts survive.

Vibranium Strike Gauntlets.when: Flash at instant speed on an attacker.

Vigorbloom Charm.target: Protect T'Challa, or draw, or fight.

W'Kabi, Shield of the Nation.synergy: Every T'Challa attack with a 4+ MV artifact out = 4/4 Rhino.

Wakanda Forever!.target: Put the best permanent onto the battlefield with an indestructible counter.

Winds of Abandon.when: Single target early; overload (6 mana) as a one-sided wipe.
Winds of Abandon.hold: Hold the overload for a big board.

Zuri, Warrior of Wakanda.synergy: Every MV 4+ artifact = +1/+1 counter on every creature.

The Vision.when: Turn 4 (MV 4 artifact → two +1/+1 counters on T'Challa, so cast it after he's out).
The Vision.target: Attack in the air with vigilance.
The Vision.synergy: Every noncreature spell (all your artifacts, equipment, removal) gives it double strike, indestructible or a card — pick card draw first in most turns. Colorless, so Forsaken Monument gives it +2/+2.
